svg.title: The Portal: design schools
svg.desc: The seven design schools of the Portal side by side, each shown in its own real colors and display face with the same wordmark and the same shared sentence, above the files that make a school: shared copy and paths, the Portal runtime and switcher, one school's folder, its route and the guards.

text.tspan: One sentence, seven schools: “You talk to the person who builds it.”
